details.detail: Surface detail: seams, fastener rows, slat band, gear stripe
details.note: The panel jitter went from 0.10 to 0.15, but the change is still invisible at window range: the w17A/w19A skin reads as one flat grey. KN41 shows strong panel-to-panel tone steps on the spoiler and flap panels, visible rivet rows, a red placard and grime at the TE. The slat line is now 0.04 and holds better in w17A. The gear stripe is correct.

The hinge line and chordwise breaks are now thin and light (brk #7a7f86, 0.014), and only the spoiler-TE/flap gap reads dark. That matches _7250. In 19A the line hierarchy now looks like KN41. The panels themselves have no tone contrast: in KN41 the spoilers and flaperon are a shade darker and bluer than the fixed skin.

Regressed from 7.5. The w5 'blunt rounded end' (tail lerp to 0.32/0.30, RE 0.12) turns every canoe in 26K into a flat-ended thumb or paddle. The 1/3 overhang is still there, and the end is cut square. The flank is one uniform tone (#a8acae to #aaadb0 down the whole side at x 560-600 in w26K), with only a thin dark keel line. In _7250 the canoes taper to a point and are strongly two-tone: lit upper flank #e0e8ea, shaded lower flank #788186 (ratio about 0.55). The rounded sections are fine; the ends and the flank shading are not.
Unchanged. In 13A and in the close-up the fairing ridge rises into the LE as in LALF _137 and KN 7A.

details.detail: Nacelle geometry (cowl, lip, splits, strake, access panel)
details.note: The access panel is now a near-square rounded rectangle (0.42 x 0.40 m) with a faint outline, close to KN 7A and LALF _136 (see c_nacelle_left). The strake shadow is thinner (s13A/w13A) and now reads as a lit edge with a shadow line, not a slot. In the close-up the strake plate itself reads slightly thick and bright, like a plank: in KN 7A it is a thin chine with a shadow under it.

The cowl and lip are neutral and the splits are dark hairlines. The monogram has moved to 2.0 m / -30 deg, but it is still outside every QA view; only the c_ge_inboard_left close-up shows it. There it is block sans-serif 'GE' in a thin ring. The real mark (KN 7A, IQCFQpV_T1A) is the GE script swirl monogram, with a small 'GE' wordmark beside it. It also sits further forward and lower than the model's, near the lower inlet cowl.

Fixed. The inner barrel is now a lit grey that grades darker toward the fan: w11K #9ca5ac -> #7c848b (r5 #242629 -> #576068) and w11A #333d4d -> #445061 (r5 #1c212b -> #101115). KN 7A shows #869bb0 -> #81858e. It no longer reads as a black hole. The far wall in w11K is still slightly uniform: KN 7A shows the acoustic liner darkening to #363530 before the fan face.

Fixed and slightly overshot. The ink is now near-black navy: #171b25 in w17K and #171b26 in w26K, against skin #b1b8c1, an ink/skin luminance ratio of about 0.13. _7250 has #323b40 at about 0.25, and KN41 reads dark navy. The strokes are bolder. From 17K the grazing angle still smears the glyphs into streaks, and 9/5 are hard to read. In w26K the letters sit at the very top of the pane, partly behind the shade.
Unchanged. The discharger comb shows at the tip in w19A. In n19A the red nav light is a small point, and the belly beacon washes the canoes and cowl red.

The LE dot fringe is gone (the dots now stop at s 22). There is a new small artefact: the 0.009 access-panel outline tube breaks into a dotted line in w11K (/tmp/claude-0/ratB6/w11K_nac.png). There is no z-fighting at the splits or the registration.

issues.problem: The blunt rounded ends added in w5 make the canoes read as square-cut paddles in 26K. The flank is one flat tone, so the canoes have no visible volume. The photos show tails that taper to a point and a clear lit-upper / dark-lower flank split.
issues.evidence: w26K: flank #a8acae-#aaadb0 down the whole side at x 560-600, y 365-395, and flat-cut ends (/tmp/claude-0/ratB6/r6_26K_canoe.png). _7250: lit flank #e0e8ea against lower flank #788186, pointed tails at (420,935) and (820,615).
issues.fix: In the canoe loop of 11_exterior.js, keep `r: Math.min(w * 0.42, d * 0.4)`. Go back to a tapered tail: `fw * lerp(1, 0.18, tail(xn))` for width and `fw * lerp(1, 0.14, tail(xn))` for depth. Change the end sections to `for (const u of [0.5, 0.85]) { const e = Math.sqrt(1 - u * u); secs.push(sec(x1 + u * RE, 0.18 * e + 0.03, 0.14 * e + 0.03)); }` with RE 0.10. Change the canoe shading `shadeVerts(B, vC, vN, (p, n) => 1 - 0.35 * Math.max(0, -n[1]))` to `(p, n) => 0.55 + 0.45 * Math.pow((n[1] + 1) / 2, 1.3)` so the vertical flank grades from top to keel (target: lower flank about 0.55-0.6 of the upper in w26K).

issues.problem: The upper skin reads as one flat CG grey. In KN41 the spoiler and flap panels are visibly a different tone from the fixed skin, and the skin carries rivet rows and small placards.
issues.evidence: w19A/w17A against KN41 (a5_kn_ANA77W_TheRoom_41.jpg): in KN41 the spoiler/flaperon panels are about 6-10 % darker and bluer than the fixed skin, and there is a red placard at (290,550).
issues.fix: In paintVerts, give the movable surfaces their own tone: when uv[0] lies behind the spoiler hinge (x > spF(s)) or on the flaps, return the paint multiplied by 0.92 with +4 on blue. Add 3 placards on the inboard spoiler at s 5-8 as small `wingLine` quads (0.22 x 0.12 m, `{c:'#a8282c', r:0.8}` border, 0.02 wide). Add a faint rivet row (`riv`, 0.012) 0.1 m inside each spoiler edge.

issues.problem: The mark is block sans-serif 'GE' in a ring, and it still appears in no QA view. The real mark is the GE script monogram (swirled letters in a ring) with a small 'GE' wordmark beside it, low on the inlet-side cowl.
issues.fix: In the monogram block, replace the block letters with script swashes: 3 curved strokes inside the ring, built from cubic points such as [[-0.15,0.02],[-0.05,0.15],[0.02,0.02],[-0.02,-0.12],[0.12,-0.05]] and a mirrored pair. Use a stroke of 0.010 and a ring radius of 0.22 m. Add a 0.12 m 'GE' wordmark 0.35 m forward of the ring. Move it to xc 1.6, ac -40 deg so it shows from 13A/11A at ground pitch, and add a QA view (13A pitch -0.35) to check it.

issues.detail: registration ink slightly too dark / smeared at grazing
issues.problem: The ink overshot to near-black, at a ratio of about 0.13 against about 0.25 in _7250. From 17K the strokes smear.
issues.fix: Set the ink to `{ c: '#0f1a30', r: 0.9, m: 0 }`. Keep the stroke at 0.31. Optionally widen the gap between letters: change sC step 1.15 -> 1.22 so 9 and 5 separate at grazing angles.

issues.problem: The 0.009 m outline tube breaks into dots at 11K range.
issues.fix: Draw the outline as a cowlPatch-style band (an annulus 0.014 wide baked at 0.85x the cowl tone), not a 4-sided gTube. Or raise the tube radius 0.009 -> 0.013 with colour #9ca1a7 so it holds the same faintness.

issues.problem: In the close-up the strake reads as a bright plank with a visible thickness. In KN 7A it is a thin chine.
issues.fix: Halve the strake plate thickness and shade its top face down by about 0.85 so only the leading edge catches the light.

issues.problem: The window reveals and pane-side lining render saturated royal blue in every day view (#4a5ae0-ish), and the w19A canoes are in deep shade. This dominates the frames.
